messages:
Maya Chen: Quick pulse — Lode Labs is green to start the ‘Flight Deck’ pilot next week. Need to lock enrollment links, 30m enablement slots, and a lightweight feedback plan. Who can own the runbook and demo key?
Diego Alvarez: I can run the enablement. Prefer Tue 10am PT. Can we compress to 30m (20m demo + 10m Q&A)?
Riley Park: I have the invite cadence ready. Need the 30m agenda and list of attendees. Do we want to include the product tour video in the invite?
Maya Chen: Yes — 20m demo + 10m Q&A. Agenda: 1) Quick intros (3m) 2) Integration walkthrough (15m) 3) Ops & SLAs (2m) 4) Q&A (10m). Need a demo key and a pre-survey.
Samir Patel: I’ll provision a short-lived demo key (scoped) — ETA EOD today. Suggest a 3-question pre-survey: primary use case, integration timeline, top success metric.
Nadia Ibrahim: For feedback capture: recommend pre-survey, then auto-send post-session survey after 24h and a 7-day micro-NPS. I can prep Typeform templates.
Maya Chen: Typeform works. Diego, please book Tue 10am PT and Wed 2pm PT as backup. @onboard-bot create the invites and seat links once Diego confirms.
onboard-bot: Invite created — Tue 10am PT (Zoom) sent to Lode primary contacts. Wed 2pm PT slot created, awaiting RSVP. Seat link: https://redwood.dev/pilots/lode/seat/abC123
Riley Park: Added product tour video to the invite and pinned the quickstart README. Pasted checklist in the calendar invite: 
```
- 30m agenda
- demo key (temp)
- Typeform pre-survey link
- follow-up survey template
- SLA one-pager
```
Maya Chen: Flagging a renewal risk: Lode’s renewal horizon is Feb 2025. If they don’t hit initial success (10k tokens/day) within 60 days we may lose momentum. Let’s track tokens/day and trigger CSM playbook if usage drops below 25% of forecast.
Samir Patel: I’ll add a dashboard: tokens/day, avg latency, error rate, 7d trend. Will attach alert to Maya + Riley.
Nadia Ibrahim: I'll draft the 24h and 7-day survey texts and the one-question NPS for week-1. Will create Typeform and share links here.
Diego Alvarez: Can we record the enablement and auto-upload to the customer Drive? Lode asked for the recording.
Riley Park: Recording OK. I’ll upload transcript + recording to Drive and link it in the pilot ticket.
Maya Chen: Nice. One last ask: paste pre-survey and post-survey links in this thread when ready. I’ll loop in Sales Ops for contract addendum around reserved capacity if pilot exceeds thresholds.
Diego Alvarez: Will send the Typeform links and drop final invite copy by EOD tomorrow. Onboarding loop target: tomorrow EOD. :thumbsup:
